worldcombat.skill.perishsong.summary: Fix a song domain around yourself and write the nearest living things, yourself included, onto its list; you must stay put and finish all three beats, and with every beat the things still inside the circle draw closer to the judgment. On the final beat each listed creature still carrying this song's mark takes one finite fixed damage. Running out of the domain, curing the mark, or interrupting or killing the singer voids the whole song. It is a song that counts its singer too, best used to level a fight you can outlast.
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.use.0: Level the fight when you are losing and force a rush or a retreat
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.use.1: Name a whole crowd at once
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.use.2: Take the enemy's main threat with you in a lost exchange
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.description: Starting the song fixes a domain of %1$s blocks around you; the sound passes through cover and is judged only by distance inside the circle. Each beat lasts %2$s, three beats in all, and anything that leaves the domain drops off the list at once.

On the final beat every listed creature still carrying this song's mark - friend or foe, yourself included - takes one fixed %1$s damage; that damage is set by your special attack and level and is the same for every target. Cooldown %2$s.

After starting you must sing all three beats in place; cancellation, switching out or death ends the whole song. A creature that leaves the domain drops off this list at once and does not re-enter by returning inside.
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.dirge.0: Dirge: a wider domain and longer beats, but a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.dirge.1: Lullaby: a smaller domain and shorter beats with a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.perishsong.timing: Cast around yourself: after %1$s of preparation it spends %3$s PP; the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %4$s from commit.
On: radius x1.3, beat x1.35, cooldown x1.15. Off (Lullaby): radius x0.85, beat x0.75, cooldown x0.85. Trade the size of the domain for how fast it settles.
The partner starts the song only below this health ratio; larger levels the fight sooner, smaller keeps it for when it truly cannot hold.
The partner considers the song only while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee, larger will sing at a farther foe.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to start the song.
world_combat.move.perishsong.text.song: Perish Song: %1$s heard, settles after three beats
world_combat.move.perishsong.text.withst: The three beats are done, and it held
world_combat.move.perishsong.text.resist: The three beats are done, and it was turned aside
